title: Cartoon Character Gallery
description: A high-fidelity, interactive character showcase portal featuring 12 iconic cartoon characters across three universes (90s Nostalgia, Modern Anime, Sci-Fi Cartoons). Implements a real-time string-matching search filter matrix, categorical universe chip filters, perspective-depth glassmorphic card grid with spring-easing hover transforms, a detailed slide-in bio drawer with catchphrases and stats, and a live telemetry counter tracking displayed card tallies. Built entirely with vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6+ — no frameworks or external dependencies.
